mechanism: Fenofibrate may reduce renal function and increase dorzolamide concentrations through impaired renal elimination, while dorzolamide's carbonic anhydrase inhibition can alter electrolytes affecting fibrate efficacy and safety.
action: Monitor renal function and electrolytes periodically; assess for dorzolamide accumulation signs (metabolic acidosis, hypokalemia); consider alternative glaucoma therapy if renal function declines.
